question: What Is the Allen Bradley ControlLogix 5590 PLC?
body_html:
The Allen Bradley ControlLogix 5590 PLC is the L9 generation of Rockwell Automation ControlLogix controllers, replacing the 5580 (L8) as the flagship of the platform.

It offers 2 MB to 80 MB of user memory, up to 512 motion axes, 600+ EtherNet/IP nodes, dual gigabit Ethernet ports and built in SIL 2/PLd safety in every variant. It is programmed in Studio 5000 Logix Designer version 38 or higher and supports LD, FBD, ST, SFC and IL.
